# ChunkGenerating

> **Kind:** tag · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/terrain/`](../folders/src-logic-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h)

## Summary

Chunk density is being computed on a worker thread.

## Description

Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::tick when it starts a job, removed by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect when the job is done. TerrainSys does not destroy ChunkDestroying chunks that still have it.

None (tag, opaque type or no data members).
